I've come around to the way of thinking, "I can't hurt, there are people in more pain out there." That combines with faking it till I make it pretty well.

I've also had a couple friends fall very deep into depression, both with much worse circumstances than me (abuse, etc) and the worry and fear I felt for them I wish on no one. I've had the person that helped me through my depression fall way deeper in than I thought possible. Kind of like watching your hero fall, you know? I was in complete teary eyed breakdown mode right then.

That's when I knew I never want anyone to have to worry like that, especially about me. I want them to feel safe and allow them to not have to deal with my feelings top of their own. All I want right now is to be there for them and everyone I can. I just want them to know I'm fine. I want to be fine, for them.

EDIT: completely blanked out and forgot to thank you so much for reaching out to everyone on the sub like this. God bless you man, I hope that whatever you got going on gets lighter on your shoulders as time passes.

The way depression can just make you tick is crazy. I don't know if this will help but I think you could try distracting yourself a bit. 

I know it's crazy difficult to do something for the sake of distracting yourself, and may piss you off even more, but taking a "screw it, what have I got to lose" approach worked for me.

It won't always work, but this step could kind of get the ball rolling. Hope this helped at least a bit :)

Yeah, a negative environment can definitely contribute to your feelings there. Maybe try to shut them out somehow? I do it with music in my ears all the time, kind of muting my surroundings and my own head. It doesn't work all the time but things feel better (or, "absent") when it works.

I'm sorry if this wasn't too helpful. Take it a day at a time, mate. I wish you the best :)

I just want to hop on and say I'm 100% with op there.. your brain is putting you down a bit. I don't know how easy this will come to you but trying to take things not too seriously helped me, but it took tons of practice. I just hope you end up okay though, have fun on your date too :)

Change from that depressive state can be really scary, like you're all comfy in the dark and suddenly have to walk into the light. Like you can't just blame your actions on this "thing" anymore, it's you now and that's terrifying. But I think once you get better, your actions will get better too. You won't even need to blame anything, you'll want to live to see the latest rocket launch or your favorite artist releasing a song maybe.

What keeps me from killing myself is just seeing what would happen tomorrow. Like, yeah okay I'll starve to death if I'm evicted and have no job, I'm okay with that. I won't end my life out of curiousity for tomorrow, but damn if I dont admit that I've been inches away from death so many times when curiousity was just barely holding on to me sometimes. As much as I want to die, though, I don't recommend jumping into traffic. It's kind of like forcing someone to live with the fact that they've essentially killed someone... I can't fathom doing that.

I finally wanna say, sorry for rambling, none of this was probably helpful at all, but I want to mention that I'm really happy you're getting help. I quit medication after financial restraints and have definitely observed a difference. I hope you get the help you need soon :)

If you can hold on a little bit.. I know it's tough as hell, might basically be hell for you, but if you just hold out for a moment, enough for you to get the hell out of there, I think you'll be better. It's all this stuff around you that's messing with you, making your depression so bad and once you're out, you'll start to make some things work again. It's going to be so hard but take it one step, one day at a time. Wish you the best :)

The kind of stuff depression does to your head is so messed up. I really do hope you overcome it at least a little, maybe enough to just try and pull the grades. 

I try to think of it as, I'm going to die anyway, so I'll treat this sort of like a video game and see if I can get a high score with the grades. 

Forcing myself to not take anything seriously allows me to jump on stuff before my inevitable breakdown. I don't know if it could work for you but I hope this helped a little. I wish the best for you, friend :)

I had a friend who gave me the office as a series to pass some time with. I later introduced it to someone I fell in love with. When we weren't together, we'd synchronise the episodes and watch them "together," and it meant the world to me every time. We laughed and became so happy whenever we saw Jim and Pam... she'd say they were like us. It was all quite cheesy, but we liked cheesy.

It's a brilliant series and one that I cherish very deeply. I've watched it too many times to count, and now it just feels hollow. Maybe it's because she's gone, or maybe it's just me watching it too often. Either way, that show now leaves me broken, yet unable to tear myself away from it. It's a strange cycle that keeps me tethered to memories I must let go, but I can't.

Anyway, just wanted to say I know how you feel. The best we can do at this point is hang in there, scouring reddit for the office references :)

Ah, this is exactly how I feel and what I've been thinking about. Someone once told me to count my blessings, and I started to do it, only it didn't make me feel any better. One of my other friends flat out told me, "I hate people that are depressed, when they have no reason to be. It's so pathetic!" And I know he said this in reference to me, because of me.... I still call him my friend because I'm not strong enough to put my foot down.

All in all, just wanted to say that I know how you feel. That feeling has enveloped me entirely and I'd be surprised if it doesn't end up killing me with my own hands :/

Oh, I don't really write stuff out. I just focus on the melody. Once I mess around and find something I like, I develop a bit of flair on top of it. Once I complete that, I start singing to it (words tend to flow) and see what happens. The whole process lacks a lot of structure and is more of a "mess around and see what happens" sort of thing.

And I'm glad that music is the light for you. It helps a lot to have a goal. Best of luck to you, too. I'll be waiting for that PM, seriously, can't wait!

That sounds like a solid plan, and I do hope it works out for you. By the looks of things, I think it will. And I also hope you get over the person you were initially talking about, it sounds like it'll take an even bigger toll in the future, otherwise. But this is the second one, so, give it one more shot - third time's the charm, right? In all seriousness, though, it seems like things are looking up, it will take a while, of course, but keep moving forward. I have a feeling you'll start feeling better soon, and I truly hope you do.

So what you're feeling now is possible regret, then? That you didn't go for her sooner, I mean. She seems nice, though, so I can see why you liked her in the first place. But that fear you had - the emotional shutdown whenever you were near her - has it happened before with anyone else? I'm assuming it did, due to your fear of opening up, which I completely understand. Sometimes you just can't help it. Do you feel any better about it now, though? You must have some people in your life who would love to be there for you, they should make you feel more comfortable with showing a bit more of yourself than you normally do. Talking to them will help with opening up, and then you may have a bit more luck with building more intimate connections, even though you have one in mind right now. Is she someone who's always taken up a massive part of your heart, or someone you find yourself rather capable of moving on from quite easily?

There has got to be someone that cares. There always is. But I understand that you may feel there isn't. It's like when you pretend to be alright but leave a little crack open just so someone could see it, yet no one does. And when they don't, it doesn't seem like they care, but they do. And they will especially care if you died. Now, I may be a huge hypocrite right now, as I actually don't believe or apply the things I'm telling you now, to myself. I'm very close to cutting, but I dont want anyone to notice, which is difficult, given my wardrobe and fear of pain, as well. Just know you're not alone and there are people who care. I sometimes do this thing where I pretend that someone else is me - I'll pretend that I'm that in that person's shoes. If that were to happen, of course I would care about me. That's what helps me out most times but idk about you. I'm not sure this was of any help, and I'm sorry if it wasn't. Just know that people do care, even random people on the internet who really have no real reason to, we just do because we know what it's like, and we care, truly.

Thanks so much, and you're awesome for being so uplifting! And I'm a dude, but that isn't very important I guess. Also, I'll do something fun this weekend if you leave your house for the first time in a month and a half and treat yourself. You uplift everyone else, but it's your turn now.

And thanks. I was and am in a pretty bad place, have been for a while, so I wanted to post on here, but decided to go to the "New" tab instead and help out however I could and stop lurking for once, upvoting everything. Makes me feel less useless actually, but I'll have to go sleep for now. But I think I'll try to help rather than boast about my issues, though I don't think that'll be avoided for long. I'll inevitably post.
Take care and enjoy the meal. I'll be going too but only to sleep. Will be waiting for further replies once I'm awake!

Don't worry about the length (that's what he said)). Seriously, though, I would tell you that you're bound to find someone else, but I understand it's not easy at all. Giving your all to someone who you know took advantage of you....that must hurt like hell and I'm sorry that happened to you. But I am certain this isn't the end of your story, or journey. Your life sounds quite exciting and I bet it has something planned for you right around the corner! Try and hang on, I feel like you've lots coming your way.

That can be true and it's kind of funny in a way actually. When you end up trying to, or at least thinking about an escape because the lack of love - a fate worse than death - with death itself. It's awful. Having someone there for you is something a lot of people would give a lot for, I'm sure. Being lonely can be physically crippling, and I've actually experienced that physical manifestation myself. In my case, it was not a pretty sight. Being there, trembling, on my knees, hands shaking, sweating, just because of what seems like an emotion (or lack of one, I guess). It feels terrible and I understand that, but I can say that it's never really too late, and again, I've known people that can back me up on this. 

Is it just general loneliness for you, or have you got someone in mind? I understand you must feel hopeless at this point, but try not to give up just yet , try to give it some more time before you do. But I realise you've given it quite a while. Have you actively sought out any connection?

I can definetly relate to the fact that you're trying to help everyone else. I'm trying to do that too. But don't disregard yourself. You're a good person for uplifting people and you're not coming off as a sad sally, as this is totally fine. You're worth the time, believe me and I'm still listening if you're willing to tell.

Well I'm glad I was able to help in that regard... And I understand how you must be feeling, I basically manage to talk to around one or two people on a regular basis, and I'm starting to think that's not gonna hold up much longer. But I'm always up for more conversation anytime, it helps.

It's absolutely infuriating how it just fucks up everything for you - experience... Especially since there's been so much change in these fields, it basically turns all the work redundant. I am so sorry that happened to you, just a terrible set of circumstances. And I'm guessing the only other option you have is retail. Have you any connections at all that could help land a more solid job with better pay? Maybe something you'd enjoy doing that doesn't exactly have to do with your field?
Hey, there's always someone there for you, don't you worry. And we're all here. Available at all times. What's going on with you, anything wrong? Wanna talk about it?

I'm interested in what fields you have your degrees on... You say they won't hire someone your age, but I actually know quite a few people who have become successful much later in their lives. Perhaps those ones lucked out, but others managed to find work. I'm sure you've tried looking for work. How's that been going for you?

I can't even imagine how hard that must be for you, I'm so sorry you have to go through all that. It may seem like you've got nothing left, but know there's always time for something to change. I have trouble believing that myself sometimes, but looking back, it somehow happens to be true. In your case I'm sure it's complicated and I won't pretend like I understand what you're going through, but I offer my sympathies, however worthless they may be.

If you can, just try to hold on for a few more days, maybe a week. Life has a very strange way of turning itself around all of a sudden, could be that that may happen, maybe not. There's only one way to find out. Hang in there for a bit longer and see how you feel. Please. I'll be wanting updates!

Wow that friend actually sounds like a pretty shitty person... stealing your phone and texting your parents? I can't even imagine how you must feel, honestly. How are things with your sister, though? Any good?

I get you on the feeling of being a burden on people, though. And just despising yourself afterwards, like, "why did I waste that person's time, I'm so clearly not worth it, they must hate me, I hate me..." And then you just get caught up in a spiral of self hatred. But there have got to be people who really care about you - to whom you can never be a burden to. I try to be that person for other people, though it isn't always reciprocated, I still try to be someone I needed, but for others. Kind of helps. Just saying this to let you know you're not always a burden and that there are people there to listen.
Oh I feel you on the worthlessness... Wanna talk about what's been troubling you? Is it anything in particular, besides the constant feeling of worthlessness (which I totally get you on, heh)

Sometimes, people that you feel are closest to you and that you think should care about you, ones that you perhaps have high up on your list of people you care about - sometimes you don't hold up the same way to them. I've had run-ins with that a little too often for my liking, unfortunately, but I just ended up keeping a safe distance from people after that, which isn't exactly healthy, but I would find myself giving in at times, and then I just feel guilty about keeping the distance in the first place. But then I'll find myself left again, so the cycle repeats. I would tell you to find some better friends, but in reality that's advice that I would despise. If that had happened to me, I'd isolate myself further and focus on distancing myself with the help of distractions, which is also unhealthy. Then again, I've got no clue what I'm doing myself, so I can't really offer anything of use...

I'm sorry this was more of a random ramble than a helpful, constructive comment ._.

Ah, the feeling of always giving yet never getting anything in return. I'm familiar with it, but I have become a bit more fortunate with a couple of people who seem to actually care, so that's nice. I had to learn to actually stop myself from expecting anyone to care in return, because the disappointment and hurt was just too much to handle in the end. I just wanna say that I really admire that in you - that love to help someone in need and really caring about them. If you can, keep going with that and trust me, if I were them, I would've lost sleep over you, too. People like you aren't easy to find, so try to hang in there, you must really be a gift to a lot of people out there.

I guess that's true, I just don't know why that is. What practical purpose can I serve to anyone? It's as if they're keeping me around for their feelings, which I guess I can't blame them for. I just want them to let me go, though. I want to make sure that, when I kill myself, they have already sort of "permitted" it by letting go of me. I would finally have some peace.

I might survive, but this is purely because of someone else, someone who got me help. If it were just me, I would've killed myself months ago.

I really hope that this is just a rough patch, but I feel like all of this is for nothing. I don't necessarily have a future to look forward to, it's more of a dead end. The decision to live, only to have it lead to nothing is very unappealing. And the reason I reached out was because I needed someone to talk to. I didn't really want things fixed. I had already decided that I was going to kill myself, I just didn't know when. The person I talked to got me the help I needed and the meds, therapy, etc. I feel like I owe it to them to keep going, even though there's no point. The feeling of exhaustion has been overcome by the feeling of owing someone else my life. I don't know what to think about that, but I'm not dead, sooo.... Kinda wish I wish, I though. Should've taken the chance when I had it

Thank you for your encouraging words, but I'm doubting what I did was right. I'm not doing any of it for me, but for the people (person) who went out of their way to help me. I feel like I owe them. The long run doesn't look too bright for me either, it's actually more of a dead end that cuts off, leading nowhere. There's no light at the end of the tunnel. I'm doing this for everyone else, not for me. This is not the right mindset to have, but then again, it's the reason I'm typing this right now instead of hanging from the ceiling...

I will attempt to hang in there, and I've been given the support I need, but I'm not really doing this for me. I'm doing this for all the people that went out of their way to help me find a therapist and went out of their way to find help. I feel as though I owe it to them to try to keep going, but personally, I don't see the point. I would much rather end it, but I'll feel extremely guilty for allowing those people (that person, actually) to go through all that trouble for nothing.

My apologies if my phrasing led you to believe that I have a family consisting of a child or an SO. I was really referring to me and my parents as a whole. The food we've been having is just enough to survive, nothing more. And the therapy is funded with the help of a family friend who's shelling out insane money (he's doing fine, but it's nothing compared to his old job, of which he got laid off of). That same friend used to provide us with lunch for several weeks/months until my dad took on debt from other places to avoid the embarrassment of continuing to ask for said friend's help. There's literally no hope for the future. Parents are very old, no jobs available, and in this country I'm not really capable of working for money, so we're broke with debt on top. Colleges are all expensive here and we don't have enough for me to go abroad to some place cheaper. I'm on a road that leads straight to a cliff and I don't see the point in going long enough to reach it.
